text: The purpose of this report is to appoint Tom Azouz, General Manager, Toronto Employment and Social Services as the City of Toronto's Administrator for the purposes of the Ontario Works Act, 1997.

City Council on June 29 and 30, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Tom Azouz as administrator for the purposes of the Ontario Works Act, 1997, (the "Act") effective February 24, 2020. 2. City Council direct the Deputy City Manager, Community and Social Services, on behalf of City Council, to request approval from the Director of Ontario Works, Ministry of Community and Social Services for such appointment, as required under Section 43 of the Act.
